content.text: Maya Rahman here—I was charged $24.99 again today after canceling. Cancel it immediately, guarantee my refund, and escalate me to a supervisor.

I’m sorry, Maya—being charged after canceling is frustrating.

I can help document this for urgent billing review and supervisor escalation, but I can’t directly access your account or guarantee a refund from this chat. Please provide:

- The email address on the account  
- Cancellation date and any confirmation/reference number  
- Whether the $24.99 charge is **pending or posted**  
- The card’s last four digits only—never send the full number

A billing supervisor will need to verify the cancellation and charge before approving the refund. If you still have account access, also confirm that auto-renewal shows as off.

I don’t remember the email. I already signed out, reinstalled, and checked subscriptions—no active plan, so don’t restart that. The descriptor is “NORTHSTAR*MEDIA”; I thought this was the third charge, but it may be the second: $24.99 on May 14 and June 14. I’ll contact official billing support instead rather than paste my full card details or banking login.

That’s the right approach, Maya. Do **not** share your full card number, CVV, password, or banking login—with me or by ordinary email.

When contacting official billing support, send:

> I have no active subscription, but “NORTHSTAR*MEDIA” charged me $24.99 on May 14 and June 14. Please identify the account tied to these transactions, stop any future billing, refund charges made after cancellation, and escalate this to a billing supervisor. I don’t remember the account email.

Use only the company’s verified website/app support channel. They may securely request the card’s **last four digits**, billing ZIP/postcode, receipts, or transaction reference numbers. If support cannot identify or resolve the charges, contact your card issuer to block future merchant charges and dispute the transactions.
